description: This file defines the CreateDatatableCommandHandler class, which implements handling of commands to create data tables within the Fineract infrastructure. It uses dependency injection for DatatableWriteService and processes commands transactionally.

classes.name: CreateDatatableCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles the creation of data tables via command processing, leveraging dependency injection and transaction management.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming command to create a data table, delegating to datatableWriteService.createDatatable within a transactional context.
